projects.title: AutoGuard
projects.subtitle: AI-based predictive vehicle health monitoring
projects.description: Major project: AI vehicle health monitoring with a Streamlit dashboard UI for real-time sensors, predictive alerts, and maintenance insights.

caseStudy.overview: AutoGuard is my B.Tech major project — an AI-based vehicle health monitoring system. I designed and built the dashboard UI (dashboard.py) so drivers can view live sensor data, health scores, predictive alerts, and maintenance recommendations in one place.
caseStudy.problem: Drivers often face unexpected breakdowns due to limited visibility into vehicle health before failures occur.
caseStudy.research: Studied sensor data patterns, maintenance workflows, and user needs for preventive alerts in automotive contexts.
caseStudy.userFlow: Designed flows for monitoring vehicle health, viewing predictive alerts, and scheduling preventive maintenance from the dashboard home screen.
caseStudy.wireframes: Designed the dashboard layout in Figma, then implemented the UI in Python (Streamlit) as dashboard.py — sidebar navigation, KPI metrics, sensor charts, and alert panels.
caseStudy.designSystem: Dark automotive dashboard theme with status colors (healthy / warning / critical), monospace labels for technical data, and card-based component status blocks.
caseStudy.results: Delivered a working dashboard connected to engine sensor data with ML-based anomaly detection and maintenance alerts for preventive care.
caseStudy.lessons: Presenting complex sensor data clearly helps users trust AI-driven recommendations.

projects.title: Apple iPhone Landing Page
projects.subtitle: Responsive product experience in Figma
projects.description: A responsive iPhone landing page focused on user experience, visual hierarchy, typography, and modern UI principles.

caseStudy.overview: Designed a responsive iPhone landing page in Figma, focusing on user experience, visual hierarchy, typography, and modern UI principles.
caseStudy.problem: Product landing pages need to balance rich storytelling with fast discovery of key actions like buy, trade-in, and support.
caseStudy.research: Analyzed Apple's design language and best-in-class landing pages for inspiration on hierarchy and conversion paths.
caseStudy.userFlow: Mapped journeys for product discovery, trade-in, support, and customization sections.
caseStudy.wireframes: Created wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for all major page sections.
caseStudy.designSystem: Applied consistent typography, spacing, and component patterns for a polished editorial feel.
caseStudy.results: Delivered high-fidelity prototypes improving usability and engagement across key user flows.
caseStudy.lessons: Strong visual hierarchy guides users through complex product pages without overwhelming them.

projects.title: Donut Hero Section
projects.subtitle: Modern hero section concept
projects.description: A visually rich landing hero design for a donut-themed brand with strong typography, product focus, and conversion-first layout.

caseStudy.overview: Designed a hero section concept for a donut brand focused on clear product communication and modern visual appeal.
caseStudy.problem: Food brand landing pages often struggle to balance aesthetics with clear call-to-action focus.
caseStudy.research: Reviewed top-performing hero sections in food and e-commerce websites to identify strong layout patterns.
caseStudy.userFlow: Optimized first-screen scanning flow: headline -> product visual -> CTA.
caseStudy.wireframes: Created multiple layout options and selected the version with best readability and balance.
caseStudy.designSystem: Applied consistent color accents, spacing rhythm, and modern type scale.
caseStudy.results: Produced a clean and engaging hero concept suitable for real brand deployment.
caseStudy.lessons: First impressions are driven by hierarchy and whitespace as much as visuals.

projects.title: Nike Hero Section
projects.subtitle: Sport-focused hero concept
projects.description: A high-energy hero section inspired by sports branding, designed to emphasize product identity and action-driven messaging.

caseStudy.overview: Designed a Nike-inspired hero section concept with bold visuals and conversion-oriented content blocks.
caseStudy.problem: Sports product pages need to communicate speed, confidence, and utility immediately on first view.
caseStudy.research: Analyzed hero designs across sportswear brands and identified key visual triggers for performance products.
caseStudy.userFlow: Structured user attention from brand statement to product highlight and CTA.
caseStudy.wireframes: Built and tested multiple high-contrast hero layouts in Figma.
caseStudy.designSystem: Used bold typography, limited color palette, and strong component contrast.
caseStudy.results: Created a polished concept with strong visual impact and clear purchase intent direction.
caseStudy.lessons: Bold concepts work best when interaction goals remain simple and obvious.

projects.title: Veltrix.8 GPT Website
projects.subtitle: AI product website concept
projects.description: A concept website for an AI platform (Veltrix.8) with a clean product narrative, modern UI patterns, and trust-building structure.

caseStudy.overview: Designed the website concept for Veltrix.8, an AI/GPT product, focusing on clarity, credibility, and product storytelling.
caseStudy.problem: AI product sites often overuse technical jargon and fail to communicate practical value quickly.
caseStudy.research: Studied successful AI/SaaS websites and identified best practices for feature explanation and trust signals.
caseStudy.userFlow: Crafted a flow from problem statement -> solution features -> proof/trust -> call to action.
caseStudy.wireframes: Produced wireframes for hero, features, pricing, and CTA sections.
caseStudy.designSystem: Created a modern dark-themed style with consistent cards, spacing, and iconography patterns.
caseStudy.results: Delivered a structured concept website that communicates AI product value clearly.
caseStudy.lessons: For AI websites, plain language and hierarchy are more important than visual complexity.
